about_the_game:
Myth of Valderit is a psychological horror experience set in “Valderit”, a cursed village, inspired by the abandoned Catalan village of La Mussara. You wake up as Nil, separated from your friends, Julia and Enric, and soon discover the dark secrets of this cursed village…

Gameplay

Single-player, first-person experience, Myth of Valderit combines exploration, survival elements, and puzzle-solving. Nil will have to survive and avoid being chased by the sect of Slygaroth without no weapon to defend from them. 

Explore the things that are waiting for you in Valderit:

Survive the sect:

Solve puzzles to advance in the story and know more about what is happening: 

A village that knows how to scare you: 

With an innovative Adaptive AI system, that analyses how you react to fear and adapts the game in real time: level layouts shift, music and atmosphere, even the placement of threats changes according to your behaviour. You will face the game in your own way.


It’s real or it is on your mind:

A unique sanity mechanic distorts perception, walls move, sounds deceive, objects that change place and visions twist what you believe to be real. These elements ensure that the game offers new encounters and perspectives, keeping tension alive across multiple playthroughs.

Storytime and Environment

A Lovecraftian inspired narrative will take you into one trip of friends that starts in the forest next to Valderit, after a few beers the group of friends go to sleep.

 

And in the blink of an eye the little adventure takes Nil back in time to 1693. Where he will find the old church, and a cursed town with his houses and his catacombs. Between a dense atmosphere he will discover the darker side of reality. 

Shadows whisper, rituals leave disturbing traces, and an ancient presence that watches his every step and wants to kill him. In this journey you must decide whether to run, face the unknown, or even sacrifice yourself… 

Loom Studios invites you into an adventure where fear is never the same twice. Step into Valderit and uncover its truth… if you dare.

Social Media and Discord links can be found on our webpage, follow us and become part of the Myth!

content_descriptors.notes:
In this game, no type of violence, sexual content, or sensitive content is shown directly.
However, the results of acts of violence that took place before the player arrives at certain locations will be visible, such as corpses and skeletons.

There is a single instance where adults aged 21+ can be seen consuming alcohol.

The only crime understood to occur in the game is murder (committed by those who are clearly identified as villains).
In this regard, we would like to emphasize two points:

At no time will murders be shown being carried out.

It is fiction and a fundamental part of the game to create a horror atmosphere. The team is completely against any kind of murder or aggression toward any person or animal, and we strongly condemn it.

There will be no form of apology for, or depiction of, sexual themes or suicide.
Furthermore, we want to stress that we do not promote any type of crime, or discrimination.
There is no political opinion expressed, either in favor of or against anyone.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 o AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This information applies to the current state of our project demo, as well as the forecast for the full game in its current stage of production. We will provide updates in case of any possible changes due to production.

short_description: Myth of Valderit is an immersive first-person psychological horror game. You are Nil, trapped in a cursed village that appears under the full moon. Uncover secrets, solve twisted puzzles, and escape if you can. Valderit watches, and knows how you fear.
